positionImpact: HOOD is below your cost basis and is a meaningful portfolio weight. Review downside tolerance before adding exposure.
nextStep: Check the account's current HOOD exposure and whether the author changes the stated support and target levels.

title: A bullish NVDA view met a small capital-account exit
summary: A high-ranked author stayed bullish while a Smart-tier public account later closed about $99 of NVDA long exposure.
conclusion: The directions differ, but the observed account exit is too small to outweigh the creator evidence. Treat it as a weak divergence, not a bearish signal.
positionImpact: NVDA is the largest position in your sample portfolio and trades above your cost. Avoid allowing confirmation to increase concentration without a position limit.
nextStep: Watch for larger NVDA position changes across multiple Smart-tier capital accounts before changing concentration.
limitations: The confirmation window contains one qualified author update and one qualified public account action.
Public positions represent only bSmart's covered derivatives market.
